title: Emerald coin
description: This resource pack changes emeralds and emerald blocks into coins and coin blocks!
body:
This resource pack makes **emeralds look like coins** and **emerald blocks into coin blocks**!

![Emerald block new texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/422aeeb1b84546099a3f5aaea893889ed08631b7.png)

This makes minecraft logic more realistic as villagers are attracted to **coins** instead of emeralds.

![Villager trading with the new coin texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bdcac9f210e0d6396838be17abd728b1a0fe182e.png)

_Have fun and play now with the new textures!_
